secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Optional Supabase project URL. The app runs standalone with local data if absent; only needed to enable Supabase-backed admin editing.

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Optional Supabase anon key. Paired with VITE_SUPABASE_URL.

secrets.name: VITE_AI_ENDPOINT
secrets.description: Optional external AI backend URL for the Saqr AI page. Must not contain provider API keys.
